# `WheelSlotNum`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Discovered filter-wheel slot names.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyWheelNum @0xb19f0 (64-bit build) |

Sent once the slot-count step (slot-count reader, reached from open_wheel) has built the slot map. Custom producer; no state, code or error. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No APK consumer is established. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"WheelSlotNum"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `slots` | array<string> | yes | - | Slot names in ascending slot-id order. The ids are not serialized; only the string values. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, slots - Three slots (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"WheelSlotNum","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","slots":["Dark","IR cut","LP"]}
```
